hotels.title: Stylish Adelaide CBD Stay at Mantra Adelaide Central by Accor
hotels.description: Set in Adelaide’s CBD, this contemporary retreat places you steps from Rundle Mall’s fashion boutiques and the laneway bars and restaurants of Leigh Street and Peel Street. Adelaide Central Market is a short tram ride away, where traders serve fresh oysters, handmade pasta and small-batch cheeses. Spacious studios and apartments feature kitchen facilities, laundry amenities and private balconies suited to longer city stays. Guests also have access to a heated indoor pool, fitness centre and sauna, with Adelaide Oval and the Art Gallery of South Australia within easy reach
